definitions.explanation: Ordinal counter attaching to a number plus {年|ねん} to mark the Nth year since something started, such as a job, a marriage, or any ongoing situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三年目|さんねんめ}だ。
examples.english: This year is my third year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{五年目|ごねんめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was promoted in my fifth year at the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{十年目|じゅうねんめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: To mark our tenth year of marriage, our family went on a trip together.

notes:
Combines a counter (⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ years) with the ordinal suffix ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (Nth). The counted year is inclusive: {一年目|いちねんめ} is the first year, not the year after the first.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{三年目|さんねんめ}: third year at the company
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{十年目|じゅうねんめ}: tenth year of marriage
- ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧{二年目|にねんめ}: second year of study abroad
- ⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧{百年目|ひゃくねんめ}: hundredth year since founding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧: a span of N years (duration) — ⟦{三年間|さんねんかん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧ "for three years"
- ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: N years later — {三年後|さんねんご} "three years from now"
